name: Bluff Body CFD Benchmark
description: A collection of canonical CFD test cases and reference measurements for assessing prediction accuracy of aerodynamic responses of bluff bodies.
evaluation_method: error_metrics (RMSE / MAE / L2 error on predicted aerodynamic coefficients and force/pressure fields)
general_score_metric: RMSE (or MAE) on aerodynamic coefficients such as drag and lift; optionally L2 error on pressure/velocity fields
reputation: A niche but well-regarded collection of canonical CFD test cases used by researchers validating bluff-body aerodynamic predictions and CFD solvers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on numerical CFD predictions; results strongly depend on mesh/resolution and solver details, so reproducibility can be sensitive; dataset size and case diversity vary by subcase; not susceptible to text-contamination but subject to simulation fidelity and experimental-measurement alignment issues.
